title: Phase 2a Randomized PoC of AMG 691 + Tezepelumab vs Tezepelumab Monotherapy in Non-Remitting Severe Asthma & CRSwNP
population: Adults with severe uncontrolled asthma (or comorbid CRSwNP) with incomplete clinical remission after >=24w biologic therapy OR baseline serum sCD30 >= 65 U/mL & FeNO >= 25 ppb
arms: 3-Arm (1:1:1, N=135 total / 45 per arm): Arm 1 AMG 691 + Tezepelumab 210 mg Q4W; Arm 2 Tezepelumab 210 mg + Placebo Q4W; Arm 3 AMG 691 Monotherapy Q4W (24w treatment + 24w off-drug TFR follow-up)
primary_endpoint: Week 24 Clinical Remission Composite (ACQ-6 < 1.5, 0 exacerbations, 0 OCS, pre-BD FEV1 +>=100 mL) + Bronchial Brushing CD30+/GATA3+ T_RM2 Depletion Substudy
key_secondary_tfr_endpoint: Week 48 Sustained Off-Drug Remission Rate (24 weeks after stopping therapy at Week 24) & Segmental Allergen Late Asthmatic Response (LAR FEV1 AUC)
biomarker_enrichment: Serum sCD30 (ELISA), blood eosinophils, FeNO, nasal/bronchial brushing TNFSF8/TNFRSF8/TSLP qPCR signature (GSE193816-derived)
statistical_power: 85% power (two-sided alpha=0.10) to detect jump in clinical remission from 32% (Tezspire mono) to 58% (+26% delta)

title: Phase 2a Induction-Remission & Treatment-Free Durability Study of AMG 691 + Dupilumab (or Sequential Rocatinlimab -> AMG 691) in Moderate-to-Severe Atopic Dermatitis
population: Moderate-to-severe AD (EASI >= 16, vIGA-AD >= 3) including patients with partial response or prior rapid relapse off anti-IL-4Ra/IL-13 therapy; enriched for serum sCD30 >= 75 U/mL
arms: 2-Stage Design (N=120): Weeks 0-16 AMG 691 + Dupilumab vs Placebo + Dupilumab (2:1); Week 16 EASI-75 responders withdraw all biologics through Week 52 to measure Treatment-Free Remission (TFR)
primary_endpoint: Week 16 EASI-90 & vIGA-AD 0/1 Rate + Tape-Strip/Punch-Biopsy Clearance of Dupilumab-Persistent CD30L+/CD30+ T_RM Signature (GSE157194 Benchmark)
key_secondary_tfr_endpoint: Week 52 Off-Drug Relapse-Free Survival (36 weeks drug-free maintenance of EASI-75)
biomarker_enrichment: Serum sCD30, TARC (CCL17), non-invasive skin tape-strip TNFSF8/TNFRSF8/OX40/IL13 transcript score
statistical_power: 88% power (alpha=0.05) to detect Week 52 off-drug EASI-75 maintenance increase from 25% to 60% (+35% TFR delta)
internal_amgen_synergy: Positions AMG 691 (and AMG 691 x OX40L/IL-13 2.0) as the definitive AD off-drug remission standard

title: Phase 2a VEGA-Style Platform Study of AMG 691 + Wezlana (Ustekinumab) vs Each Monotherapy in Anti-TNF-Experienced Moderate-to-Severe Ulcerative Colitis
population: Adults with moderately-to-severely active UC (Modified Mayo 5-9, Endoscopic Subscore >= 2) with inadequate response or intolerance to >=1 anti-TNF or JAKi
arms: 3-Arm VEGA Design (1:1:1, N=150 total / 50 per arm): Arm 1 AMG 691 + Wezlana; Arm 2 Wezlana + Placebo; Arm 3 AMG 691 Monotherapy (head-to-head benchmark vs Merck MK-8690/PRA052 NCT07463183!)
primary_endpoint: Week 12 Clinical Remission & Endoscopic Improvement (Mayo Endoscopic Subscore <= 1 without friability)
key_secondary_tfr_endpoint: Week 52 Histologic-Endoscopic Mucosal Improvement (HEMI, Geboes < 3.1) & Fecal Calprotectin < 150 ug/g on Q8W Maintenance
biomarker_enrichment: 9q33.2 TNFSF8 risk haplotype stratification + baseline rectal biopsy CD30L/CD30/IL23A score (PROTECT GSE109142 non-remitter signature) + serum sCD30
statistical_power: 84% power (two-sided alpha=0.10) to detect Week 12 endoscopic improvement jump from 28% (mono) to 52% (+24% VEGA-calibrated delta)
internal_amgen_synergy: 100% Internal Amgen Combo (AMG 691 + Wezlana) Directly Leapfrogging Merck MK-8690

title: Phase 2a Basket PoC of AMG 691 + Anti-IL-17/TNF SOC in Biologic-Refractory Hidradenitis Suppurativa (Hurley Stage II/III)
population: Adults with moderate-to-severe HS (>=5 abscesses/nodules, draining tunnels <= 15) refractory to prior anti-TNF or anti-IL-17 monotherapy
arms: Randomized Add-On (2:1, N=75: 50 AMG 691 + Background Adalimumab/Secukinumab vs 25 Placebo + Background SOC through Week 16)
primary_endpoint: Week 16 HiSCR75 (75% reduction in abscess and inflammatory nodule count without new draining fistulas) & IHS4-55
key_secondary_tfr_endpoint: Dermal Tunnel Ultrasound Depth Reduction & Skin Biopsy B/T-Cell Tertiary Lymphoid Aggregate Collapse (GSE154773 CD30=1.71 / CD30L=3.28 TPM)
biomarker_enrichment: Lesional skin / serum sCD30, sIL-2R, CRP, and baseline draining tunnel count
statistical_power: 80% power (two-sided alpha=0.10) to detect HiSCR75 increase from 22% to 48% (+26% delta)
internal_amgen_synergy: Internal Amgen Combo Option with Amjevita (Adalimumab) or Tavneos (Avacopan)

title: Phase 2a Proof-of-Mechanism Study of SC AMG 691 + Oral Fipaxalparant (AMG 655) in Early Diffuse Systemic Sclerosis / SSc-ILD
population: Early diffuse cutaneous SSc (<=5 years from first non-Raynaud symptom, mRSS 15-35, elevated CRP/ESR or early HRCT ILD)
arms: Randomized 2-Arm (1:1, N=60): SC AMG 691 Q4W + Oral Fipaxalparant vs Placebo + Oral Fipaxalparant (on stable background MMF allowed) for 24 weeks
primary_endpoint: Week 24 ACR CRISS Composite Response Probability & Change in Skin Punch-Biopsy CD30L/LPAR1 Fibro-Inflammatory Transcript Score (PRESS GSE130955 Benchmark)
key_secondary_tfr_endpoint: Week 24 Change in mRSS, FVC (mL), and Quantitative HRCT Lung Fibrosis Extent
biomarker_enrichment: PRESS-derived dermal CD30L/POSTN/COL1A1 biopsy signature + serum sCD30 & KL-6
statistical_power: 80% power (two-sided alpha=0.10) to detect median ACR CRISS improvement from 0.25 to 0.60
internal_amgen_synergy: 100% Internal Amgen Biologic + Oral Antifibrotic Pair (Zero Antibody Co-Formulation Risk)
